title: the secrets-as-files probe refuses any plaintext secret literal in compose.yaml or a referenced service config
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-docker-compose-host v1.0.0 blueprint on a project with sensitive material
iWant: the secrets-as-files probe to walk compose.yaml and every referenced service config in the fixture and refuse on any plaintext secret literal, naming the file and line
soThat: a secret accidentally inlined in a review is caught by the probe before docker compose up runs

acceptanceCriteria.description: The secrets-as-files-scan probe walks compose.yaml plus every referenced service config file in the applied fixture and asserts (a) no line contains the applied plaintext token pattern (literal name plus literal value), (b) every declared secret in the compose secrets: key has a file: source, and (c) SIMULATE_PLAINTEXT_SECRET=true writes a plaintext literal into compose.yaml and the probe FAILS naming the file and the literal.

F-10 wrong-mode probe: SIMULATE_WRONG_MODE_SECRET=true sets the service-level secrets mode to 0o644. The secrets-as-files-scan probe FAILS naming the service and the mode value; the probe pattern matches the compose mode: field in the service secrets block.
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" naming the service and the disallowed mode

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-10 orphan-secret probe: SIMULATE_ORPHAN_SECRET=true adds a top-level secret entry no service references. The secrets-as-files-scan probe FAILS naming the orphan secret; the probe walks the compose service list and matches every top-level secret against a service-level secrets: array entry.
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" naming the orphan secret

acceptanceCriteria.description: Plaintext secret in .env: SIMULATE_PLAINTEXT_SECRET_IN_ENV=true writes a token literal (e.g. HCLOUD_TOKEN=... with a real-shaped value) into .env; the secrets-as-files-scan probe walks compose.yaml AND .env AND every referenced service config, and FAILS naming the .env file and the line number carrying the token pattern.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with SIMULATE_PLAINTEXT_SECRET_IN_ENV=true writing a token into .env
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" naming .env and the line with the token pattern

acceptanceCriteria.description: Clean fixture passes with zero findings: the shipped cf fixture (no SIMULATE_* flags) passes the secrets-as-files-scan with zero findings; the probe report aggregates to pass and lists the files scanned (compose.yaml plus every service-referenced config).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shipped fixture with no simulate switches
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "pass" with zero findings and the scanned-files list
